_readme: Real recurring market events that unlock a one-day special session in TRADE. Weekdays: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday. 'pool' lists the session ids the special is drawn from (seeded by date). Add OPEC+ meeting dates under opec.dates as YYYY-MM-DD; check opec.org for the current schedule.

recurring.label: EIA PRINT SPECIAL
recurring.blurb: EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report day: trade an inventory shock.

recurring.label: STORAGE REPORT SPECIAL
recurring.blurb: EIA Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report day: trade a storage story.

opec.label: OPEC+ MEETING SPECIAL
opec.blurb: OPEC+ meets today: trade a cartel decision.
opec._source: 29 Nov 2026 per OPEC press release of 1 Nov 2026 (opec.org/pr-detail/2033620-1-november-2026.html). Add later dates as OPEC announces them.
